title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About MDOTM

MDOTM is a global leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, growing across our offices in London, Milan, and New York. We recently closed a $27M growth equity round, led by Expedition Growth Capital, to support our continued international expansion. Our proprietary platform, Sphere, currently supports over $100B in assets under management for institutional clients including Morgan Stanley, Amundi, and Zurich Bank.
Role Overview
MDOTM , a leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, is looking for an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Team. You will play a key role in supporting, enhancing, and maintaining the foundational infrastructure and tools that empower our product teams - contributing to a reliable, scalable, and efficient developer platform that enables fast and secure software delivery for Sphere, our proprietary AI-driven investment platform.
Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and automation of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases across all environments.

• Assist in the adoption and management of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible, helping provision and manage on-premise and AWS resources in a controlled, auditable, and reproducible manner.

• Work with Docker and Kubernetes to package and operate services, contributing to declarative configuration, GitOps practices, and efficient resource utilization.

• Help implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix), and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and low Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

• Contribute to embedding security best practices (OWASP Top 10, least privilege IAM, shift-left testing) into the SDLC and help automate security controls within pipelines.

• Support the management and automation of database infrastructure (MySQL, MongoDB), including provisioning, backups, and automated schema migrations.

• Automate and support the deployment, scaling, and operational health of core platform services (authentication, data pipelines, messaging) for internal consumers.

• Participate in technical design discussions, learn from architectural decisions related to infrastructure and operations, and help document runbooks and standards.

• Champion DevOps culture ("you build it, you run it") and share knowledge through demos, pair programming, and internal workshops.

Skills Required

• 1-3 years of professional experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role, with a focus on automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD

• Hands-on experience working with and contributing to CI/CD pipelines

• Practical experience with Docker and exposure to Kubernetes, including writing Dockerfiles and debugging containerized applications

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible

• Experience with at least one monitoring, logging, or alerting system (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Zabbix), and curiosity for SRE principles

• Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating common tasks

• Basic understanding of security best practices in the SDLC

• Good analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting system and infrastructure issues

• Clear English communication, collaborative spirit, and a growth mindset aligned with a culture of shared ownership and rapid feedback

Bonus points:

• Experience with event-driven systems (e.g., ActiveMQ)

• Contributions to open-source projects

• Familiarity with backend development concepts (e.g., Java/Spring Boot)

• Working knowledge of AWS fundamentals (EC2, S3, IAM)

• Financial-services or high-throughput data processing background

Why Join Us?

• Work at the leading edge of technology, leveraging our decade of experience in proprietary AI to power a platform trusted by top-tier institutional clients.

• Truly flexible work environment

title: Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Senior Accountant, Financial Reporting to join our team.

Position Description

The Senior Accountant will play a key role in supporting Oklo’s financial reporting and accounting function. Reporting to the Financial Reporting Manager, this role will assist with the preparation and execution of Oklo’s SEC reporting requirements, including quarterly and annual financial statements and related disclosures. Other responsibilities include preparing supporting schedules and tie-outs, assisting with technical accounting research, supporting month-end and quarter-end close activities, executing internal controls, and coordinating with internal and external audit teams. The ability to produce accurate, well-supported work while managing key close and SEC reporting deadlines will be a critical success factor. These tasks will require regular interaction with members of the finance and accounting team, cross-functional business partners, third-party advisors, and external and internal auditors.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Prepare and support quarterly and annual SEC reporting, including Form 10-Q and Form 10-K financial statements, footnotes, supporting schedules, and related reporting packages.

• Perform detailed tie-outs of financial statements and disclosures to the general ledger, supporting workpapers, and source documentation, and prepare quarterly SEC and US GAAP disclosure checklists.

title: Contract Writer - A Book For Those Who Have Experienced Miscarriage or Pregnancy
description:
Location: Remote
Position Overview
We are seeking a contract writer to write a Christ-centered book that addresses the profound grief, heartbreak, and questions surrounding miscarriage and pregnancy loss. Scope of Work

• Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000-75,000 words)

• Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision

• Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co. ’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment
Contract, per-project basis.
Compensation
Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.
Additional Information
Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.
Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co. ?
With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books-but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.
Proposal Requirements

Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.
Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:
1. Title and Subtitle
2. Controlling Idea (1-2 sentences)
3. One-Paragraph Summary
Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.
4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

• Their stage or season of life

• The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing

• Why this book matters to them now

• Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2-3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2-3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

• How your book overlaps with each one

• How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio
Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

• Education

• Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience

• Subject-matter expertise

• Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)

• Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline
Provide a working table of contents that includes:

• Chapter titles

• The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)
Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).
9. Timeline and Specifications
Include:

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co. , please include a brief description of each idea (1-3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. title: Machine Learning Engineer, Synthetic Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

Simulation is advancing end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages - generative world models and the synthetic data they produce are one of those. The goal of this role is to build, scale, and optimise next-generation world model architectures (GAIA and successors) and bridge them into high-throughput generation and training infrastructure, so synthetic data can dramatically accelerate autonomy development. You will post-train world models for new embodiments and behaviours (rig transfer, pose transfer, dashcam restaging), generate multimodal synthetic experience at scale, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving. You sit between ML research and engineering: collaborating with scientists on architecture and conditioning, and with platform engineers on generation jobs, training artefacts, and how synthetic data is mixed into training. Your work will decide how fast we can train, evaluate, and deploy driving models on vehicles we have barely collected from.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Model work: Post-train or ablate a GAIA rig-transfer or pose-transfer checkpoint (NVS warp, calibration/intrinsics, shortcut/distillation). Inspect failures: black margins, odometry bias, flickering, wrong curvature column.

- Generation at scale: Kick off SDS / Flyte jobs for tens of thousands of segments; debug GPU capacity, KV cache, DDIM step count, MCAP/delta-table correctness.

- Landing in training: Binarise synthetic into a corpus-compatible table, wire sampling hooks, train RL and read suite + on-road diffs.

- Capability expansion: Pose-transfer ELK/AEB sets, dashcam→Alpha3, or a new OEM rig (Nissan Proto 2.1, Gen3, BMW).

- Cross-team: Driving-model owners on mix ratios, closed-loop/eval on whether generated MCAPs are usable as suites.

- Paper / research alignment: Video generation, novel-view / camera transfer, flow-matching / distillation, data-centric training - only insofar as it changes a checkpoint or a mix we ship.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Post-train and iterate GAIA-class world models for synthetic-data capabilities: rig transfer (new camera/vehicle embodiments), pose transfer (rewritten ego trajectories), and related conditioning (geometry, calibration, actions).

- Own the generation loop: config → large-scale GPU inference → training-ready artefacts, with clear lineage from the model and settings that produced them.

- Land synthetic data in driving-model training (behaviour cloning, reward models, RL): binarisation, mix ratios, quality filters, and experiments that measure suite and on-road impact - including when synthetic should replace scarce real rig data.

- Diagnose and fix geometry, calibration, and controllability failures (intrinsics/extrinsics, NVS warps, odometry/curvature, flickering, camera-layout artefacts) that determine whether generated video is training-grade.

- Improve throughput and yield: inference optimisations (shortcut, distillation, KV cache, step count), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist.

- Expand coverage to new vehicle platforms and safety-critical scenarios (OEM bring-up; Emergency Lane Keeping / Automatic Emergency Braking).

- Partner with world-model researchers, infra, and driving-model owners so generation, evaluation, and training stay one system.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- 4+ years in applied ML / research engineering, with a track record of training and shipping neural nets, not only operating data platforms.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Perception team builds the system which learns the spatial-temporal representation and their semantic meanings of the surrounding environment of the self-driving car, i.e., the system that “perceives” the world around the car. The core challenge within Model Lifecycle is accelerating Waymo's ML development cycle. As we scale to new cities and vehicle platforms, our data volume is exploding, and our models are becoming more complex, handling more and more tasks. This team is critical to controlling that complexity.

Waymo interns work with leaders in the industry on projects that deliver significant impact to the company. • Develop metrics and analyses that explain where models fail and which data would fix those failures.

• Strong programming skills in Python.

• Ability to design controlled experiments and draw sound conclusions from quantitative results.

title: Senior People Ops Manager - Payroll & Systems
description:
About Convergent Research
Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO). We architect critical infrastructure that removes bottlenecks to breakthrough scientific research.
FROs are mission-driven, time-bound organizations built to solve important scientific and engineering bottlenecks. Convergent secures funding and provides the operational backbone that allows scientists and engineers to move quickly, from legal formation and governance to hiring, finance, communications, and operational systems. We’ve taken 14 FROs from idea to operating entity, including four launches in 2026.
 
About the Role
Payroll probably isn’t the first thing that comes to mind when you think about breakthrough science. But scientists can’t do their best work if they aren’t paid correctly, benefits aren’t working, or their organization isn’t set up to employ them.
That’s where you come in.
We’re looking for a Senior People Ops Manager - Payroll & Systems to own the people ops infrastructure that keeps Convergent and our FROs running smoothly. You’ll make sure our employees get paid accurately and on time, our policies and systems keep pace with our growth, new FROs become functioning employers, and organizations completing their missions can wind down responsibly.
This is a senior, hands-on expert role. We’re looking for someone who knows parts of this work better than we do. Someone who doesn’t just identify problems but brings recommendations, builds solutions, and sets the standard for how we operate. You’ll have significant autonomy to make decisions within your domain, with the Head of People providing final approval on decisions that impact company-wide strategy or multiple teams.
You’ll report to our Head of People and work closely with our People Ops Manager - Employee Experience, who owns recruiting, onboarding, and internal communications, and our Sr. HRBP, who serves as the primary point of contact for FRO employees. You’ll also partner with our Launch team, which coordinates the many moving pieces involved in getting a new FRO off the ground or winding one down. As we grow, there may be an opportunity to add a coordinator to support routine administrative work.
A quick note on payroll: We use TriNet as our US PEO and Rippling for UK payroll. Our providers handle tax calculations and filings, but that doesn’t mean we’ve outsourced accountability. You’ll own the accuracy of the inputs, review the outputs, and make sure issues get resolved. A second member of People Ops will provide an independent pre-run review.
This role will initially be approximately 60% hands-on execution and 40% policy development, infrastructure building, and continuous improvement. We need someone who enjoys both.

We believe in hiring individuals based on their unique talents, not on race, color, religion, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or our company policies. About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that scale it. The work spans four closely coupled areas:

•
Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

•
Velocity. The toolchains, development environments, and CI/CD that let inference engineers build, test, and ship across every accelerator platform.

•
Inference engine. The software between the accelerator kernels and the routing layer that serves every request.

•
Performance. Improving throughput, latency, cost, and reliability across the stack, with correctness treated as part of performance.

This is not a status-tracking role. You'll own outcomes end to end, often where no single team is accountable for the whole picture. There is little process to inherit, and we want to keep it that way: you'll build the minimum machinery the work needs and remove it when it stops helping. Own the programs that scale Claude’s serving fleet across accelerator and cloud platforms, from early direction through delivery.

Drive new capacity online end to end, working across compute, infrastructure, security, networking, and inference teams so one person is accountable for the whole path.

Track performance and efficiency work from opportunity to measured impact in production, with correctness held as a release criterion.

Own inference readiness for model launches alongside our launch TPMs.

description:

Au sein de notre Practice Data & Analytics , vous interviendrez sur des projets de transformation à fort impact, de la conception des architectures et pipelines de données jusqu’à leur mise en production et leur optimisation.

Ce que vous ferez

Ce que nous recherchons

title: Sr. Product Operations Manager I
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Sr. Product Operations Manager I, VR International

Our Mission is to Protect Life

We are out to make the world a safer place by solving big problems and tackling the toughest challenges in public safety. From Axon's inception building the TASER device to today's ecosystem of connected hardware and software, our focus is helping officers and agencies serve their communities with confidence, safety, and integrity. Our moonshot is bold: reduce gun-related deaths between police and the public by 50% in 10 years.

 

Virtual Reality training is a key part of that mission, enabling officers to practice de-escalation, empathy, and tactical decision-making in immersive, realistic environments. Agencies around the world are asking for it, and Axon is now scaling its VR training platform into new international markets, with launches underway or planned across Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific.

Your Impact

International expansion for Axon VR is picking up momentum and has significant potential, and we are only starting to scratch the surface. As we grow and scale, we are discovering what it takes to deploy VR training in each new market, and how needs differ by culture, region, and language. What made us successful in the US and Canada does not translate one-for-one, and every region, including EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, has its own needs.

 

As the Sr. Product Operations Manager I for VR International, you will be the key operational partner to the in-market International VR GTM Lead, who leads international strategy, pricing, and new market prioritization. Together, you will build the operational foundation that lets us expand with confidence. That means putting the right structure and processes in place so each market has what it needs, including localized content, quotes and price books that work, inventory in local warehouses, trained teams, Trial and Evaluation (T&E) kits, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). This is a role with room to grow and scale as the business does.

 

In line with the defined strategy, you will help define the foundation, put it to work in each new market, and refine it as we learn. You will work with international teams, distribution partners, and US-based teams, including Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services and Training, Supply Chain, Marketing, Proposals, Legal, Compliance, and Hardware Product Management.

 

Your work will turn international VR from a series of one-off launches into a repeatable, scalable motion that helps bring Axon's mission to agencies around the world.

What You'll Do

Direct Reports: None, individual contributor role

Boston provides meaningful morning overlap with European and international partners and afternoon overlap with our West Coast-based VR team members.

title: L2 Support Engineer
description:
Position Summary
A second-level support role involves diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues that have been escalated from the first level of support. This role requires advanced knowledge of hardware, software, and networks. Key responsibilities include advanced troubleshooting, managing escalated tickets, providing technical guidance to junior staff, and documenting solutions.
The Helpdesk Technician - Tier II plays a crucial role within the Help Desk, acting as a critical escalation point. This role is instrumental in driving operational excellence by ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and providing a high-touch customer experience. Additionally, the Helpdesk Technician - Tier II collaborates seamlessly with the Infrastructure team to optimize the end-user technology ecosystem and maintain business continuity across the company.
Responsibilities

• Troubleshoot complex issues by diagnosing, resolving or providing root-cause analysis of incidents across complex hardware, software, and network platforms.

• Receive, prioritize, and manage support ticket workflows in the ITSM systems, ensuring alignment with SLA/OLA thresholds and proactive communication with departments regarding service impacts.

• Document solutions by creating and maintaining detailed documentation of all technical issues, steps taken, and resolutions to build a knowledge base to reduce repeat incident volume.

• Participate in problem management initiatives, identifying systemic issues and recommending strategic solutions to reduce incident recurrence.

• Partner with Tier 1 Technicians to mentor, reinforce knowledge transfer around emerging technologies and best practices while improving the overall team's efficiency.

• Identify and escalate critical or unresolved issues to Level 3 support, providing detailed handover information.

• Support on-site and remote workforce environments, ensuring seamless user experience across hybrid, multi-site, and distributed operating models.

Required Qualifications

• 3-5 years of Help Desk support experience, with at least 1-2 years in a Tier II capacity within an enterprise environment.

• Strong proficiency in Windows Server/Client OS (e.g., Windows, Linux, macOS), Active Directory, Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID, software applications (e.g., M365/Microsoft Office), cloud service platform (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop/ AVD), network fundamentals (e.g., DHCP, DNS, VPN) and standard enterprise management tools (ServiceNow, NinjaOne).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify root causes of complex issues while using remote access tools.

• Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.

• Focused mindset on delivering value-added engagement with end users at all touchpoints.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently with minimal supervision, and pivot rapidly in a dynamic support landscape while maintaining quality of service.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate degree from an accredited institution with 3+ years of Help Desk experience OR

• High school diploma or GED equivalent, with 5+ years of Help Desk experience can be substituted for a degree

• IT Certifications: CompTIA Certification A+, Network+, or Security+

• Exposure to virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix) and cloud service ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP).

title: Product Design Lead (Canada)
description:
This is a fully remote role based in Canada. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada.

About Proof

We’re Proof , a high-growth company in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We’ve built a best-in-class platform trusted by thousands of law firms across the United States for Service of Process, the formal delivery of legal documents, and E-Filing. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing, delivering over a million documents per year through a network of thousands of process servers. We’re working to make the legal system more efficient, transparent, and accessible than it’s traditionally been.

Design at Proof

We design for the whole service, not just the interface. We aren't a downstream team turning tickets into screens; we help the company understand complex problems, make ambiguity concrete, and decide what should become simpler before more gets built.

Design isn't an approval gate that every decision has to pass through. Depending on the work, we may lead the problem framing, partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to explore a solution, or help a team improve work already underway. The goal is to bring the right level of design involvement while important decisions are still open.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to take on challenging product and service workflows, with a primary focus on the onboarding workflows that power legal document delivery.

Delivering documents in the real world comes with inevitable edge cases and complications. An action in the field ripples through our internal systems and what a law firm sees. For example, if a process server finds a recipient has moved, the law firm needs clarity, internal teams need to resolve the exception, and the delivery workflow changes. Designing here means understanding those connections and deciding whether the right intervention is software, a process shift, automation, or all three.

You’ll report directly to the Director of Design on a small, high-leverage team, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to frame ambiguous problems, explore tradeoffs, and shape direction before solutions are locked in.

You’ll have meaningful autonomy to frame problems, choose the right approach, and drive work forward, with close cross-functional partnership, not a prescribed playbook.

What you’ll do

• Own complex workflows end-to-end: Aid in framing problems, navigate ripple effects across operations, servers, and customers, and drive through to delivery.

• Prototype to learn: Build prototypes at the right fidelity to test assumptions, make ideas tangible, and help teams make clear decisions early.

• Work with the hood open: Share unfinished work early, invite critique, and partner with Product, Engineering, and operations while problems are still malleable.

• Design whole systems, not just screens: Create coherent workflows, interfaces, information architecture, and states across digital tools and operational processes.

• Contribute to the practice: Create and improve interaction patterns and language within your work that help Operations specialists, process servers, and law firms move through the product without having to re-learn it. Share what you learn and work alongside other designers to strengthen craft and service thinking.

How we work

Part of the work here is strengthening how we build context, shifting toward an everyday habit, not a scheduled research phase. Rather than wait for complete briefs, we dig into the mechanics of the service by shadowing Operations specialists, listening to law-firm calls, talking with process servers, and asking questions until we have a solid understanding. From there, we move fluidly between sketching, prototyping, and writing clear recommendations to help teams make confident decisions while the problem is still open.

title: Controller
description:
The Role:
SPARC Behavioral Health is seeking an experienced Controller to lead full back office accounting operations, including treasury management, and drive process improvement across a growing, multi-entity healthcare organization. This role owns the monthly close, financial statement reporting, and audit preparation, while leading a Senior Accountant and Payroll Specialist and partnering closely with the CFO on broader finance initiatives. The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable in a fast paced environment with evolving systems, and motivated to build stronger processes rather than simply maintain existing ones.
The organization is a private equity backed portfolio company, and this role should expect the reporting cadence, lender covenant requirements, and diligence rigor that come with that ownership structure.
AS the Controller, you will have responsibility for:

• Own the monthly close process, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements

• Lead treasury and cash management, including cash positioning and bank relationships

• Own payroll end to end, including processing, compliance, and recordkeeping

• Lead and mentor a Senior Accountant and a Payroll Specialist, providing review and development support

• Serve as the organization's NetSuite subject matter expert, maintaining data integrity and troubleshooting system issues

• Support an active NetSuite systems stabilization effort, including entity structure cleanup and intercompany elimination processes

• Lead audit preparation and serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors

• Identify and implement process improvements to increase close efficiency and reporting accuracy, with a goal of driving toward a 10 business day close

• Maintain and strengthen internal controls across accounting functions

• Support intercompany accounting and reconciliations across multiple entities

• Support tax compliance and reporting, including coordination with external tax preparers on income tax provisions, multi-state filings, and any sales/use tax obligations across entities

• Partner with the CFO on ad hoc financial analysis, technical accounting questions, lender and investor reporting, and special projects

• Assist with policy documentation and standardization of accounting procedures

Experience

• BA and CPA required

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a Controller or Assistant Controller capacity

• Hands on NetSuite experience strongly preferred

• Experience owning or closely overseeing payroll processing, including compliance, recordkeeping, and payroll tax knowledge

• Strong technical accounting knowledge (GAAP) with demonstrated experience preparing financial statements

• Experience managing or mentoring staff

• Prior experience supporting external audits and preparing audit ready documentation

• Experience in a private equity backed or investor reported environment strongly preferred

• Healthcare, behavioral health, or multi site services industry experience a plus, including familiarity with multi payer, multi state revenue considerations

• Track record of improving or building accounting processes, not just executing existing ones

• Strong communication skills and comfort operating with some ambiguity in a lean finance team
